title: 看鏡頭
subject: an immigration officer at counter four in taoyuan airport arrivals on the three-to-six a.m. shift, repeating 'look at the camera, left index finger, right index finger, next' to three hundred passengers off a bangkok red-eye, a man with his shoes on the wrong feet, a suitcase of dried mango, and a child making a peace sign at the camera
caption: Hard techno with a Mandarin vocal, the mid-2020s neo-rave sound of the Shanghai club scene. A distorted pounding kick drum on every beat with a rumbling tail; an acid TB-303 bassline squelching up through the filter; a metallic hoover synth stab on the hook; an open hi-hat on the offbeat; industrial clank percussion like a metal stamp on a desk. Dark warehouse mix, saturated low end, mono kick, everything compressed hard. Female mid-register vocal, deadpan and half-spoken, clipped and steady, doubled on the hook, no melisma. 150 BPM, F minor. Relentless, sleepless, deadpan-funny. No trap, no pop chorus melody, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop, no dubstep wobble.
lyrics:
[Intro - distorted kick alone, acid line rising through the filter]

[Verse 1]
凌晨三點 第四號櫃檯
曼谷的紅眼班機 剛剛落地
三百個人 從走廊湧過來
我的咖啡 已經涼了

[Pre-Chorus]
護照打開 放平
帽子 拿下來

[Chorus]
看鏡頭 看鏡頭
左手食指 按下去
右手食指 按下去
下一位

[Verse 2]
有人睡到 鞋子穿反
有人拖著 一整箱芒果乾
有個小孩 對著鏡頭比耶
我沒有笑 我真的沒有笑

[Chorus]
看鏡頭 看鏡頭
左手食指 按下去
小朋友 手放下來
下一位

[Bridge - kick drops out, acid line alone, then kick slams back]
五點四十 窗外開始亮
首爾 東京 胡志明
又一班 又一班

[Chorus]
看鏡頭 看鏡頭
右手食指 按下去
歡迎來到台灣
下一位

[Outro - kick and acid line, hoover stab, cut dead]
